_doc: Everything particular to THIS agent lives here, in people.json, prompt.md and state/. The code in this folder carries no household or business specifics, so a new agent is a copy of the folder with these files rewritten.
name: Sage
household: owner1 and owner6 example (home in Brackwater; business example-org, wedding videography in Port Alder)

desk._doc: The full desk (assistant/agent/desk.py, 2026-10-30): a WORK ask typed in chat is done in the turn by a detached Claude Code session with write tools, not relayed. enabled:false sends every line to the chat brain as before; model/max_turns/timeout_s bound one desk turn; notes_cap is how many milestone lines one job may post in the thread.

burst._doc: A Google Chat line waits until its sender has been quiet settle_s seconds, so a burst of lines gets ONE answer; a slow typist's lines wait pace_factor x their largest gap; no group waits past max_wait_s. Local channel and slash commands never wait.

capacity._doc: The capacity judge (assistant/agent/capacity.py, 2026-11-14): by code, every hour, from the ticket queue and the record of asks, it judges whether one queue is still enough. A lane whose work kept waiting gets its own parallel pass (wake-on-work, same budget); a kind of work that kept going wrong gets a focus brief (assistant/agent/specialists/) that rides along on its turns. mode: auto = opens and closes by itself inside the caps and says so once under the digest; suggest = only says the idea and waits for an owner's word; off = one queue, nothing measured. Every other number has a default in the module (window_days, wait_min, slow_days, min_per_week, trouble_min_jobs, trouble_rate, confirm_days, review_days, retire_quiet_days).
